summary: d9 is a data platform and headless content management system that operates as a fork of Directus. It provides an intuitive administrative interface to automatically transform existing SQL databases into secure APIs.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you need to quickly expose an existing relational database via a structured API and admin panel without writing custom backend scaffolding.
watchOut: As a smaller fork with moderate community traction, it may lack the extensive ecosystem, documentation, and long-term stability of its parent project or more established alternatives.
deployNotes: Being a Node.js application, it typically requires a persistent connection to your target SQL database, a reverse proxy for handling TLS termination, and process management to keep the service running.
